create.name: Heather Watson
create.bio:
Heather Watson is a Quantum-Touch practitioner and teacher, Reiki master and firewalking instructor who works from a home office set in an organic apple orchard in the forest near Sonora, in California's Sierra foothills. She describes herself as a spiritual healer and event leader since 2004, and she runs her practice as Conscious Wellness, also known as Go Live Well. She speaks Spanish as well as English.

In her private sessions she usually blends Quantum-Touch with Reiki, in which she holds master-level training from several schools, and she also gives intuitive sessions that read energy patterns and help people reconnect with their own inner guidance. Clients can come to the orchard or book a session at a distance. Beyond one-to-one work she teaches Quantum-Touch and Reiki classes, plays crystal bowls and chimes for sound baths, and guides cacao ceremonies drawn from Peruvian, Mexican and Guatemalan traditions. Firewalking is a big part of her work: she qualified as an instructor in 2011 through the programme founded by Tolly Burkan, now led by Kevin Axtell, has led walks for more than a decade, and co-teaches the instructor training in Sonora. She especially enjoys working with women and hosts women's retreats that include a firewalk.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch and Reiki sessions
courses.description: Private hands-on energy sessions at her orchard office near Sonora, or sent at a distance. Heather usually combines Quantum-Touch and Reiki in one session to help stuck energy move.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch classes
courses.description: Heather is a certified Quantum-Touch practitioner and teaches classes in the method, showing students how to focus and direct life-force energy with breath, awareness and intention. Current class dates are given on registration.

courses.title: Firewalking Instructor Training 2026
courses.description: A three-day training in Sonora, taught by Kevin Axtell with Heather, that prepares participants to lead firewalks for others after first going through each ceremony themselves. Tolly Burkan, who founded the programme, is due to give a presentation.

courses.title: Sound healing and cacao ceremonies
courses.description: Group experiences Heather leads with crystal bowls, chimes and other instruments for deep relaxation, and sacred cacao ceremonies that combine ceremonial cacao, meditation, sound and gentle movement.
